# 🕌 Varanasi — 3‑Day Trip  
> **Kolkata → Varanasi** · 15 Jan 2027 – 17 Jan 2027 · 1 person · Budget ₹12,000 · Estimated total ₹3,690  

## ✨ At a glance
- **Getting there:** Train 13151 KOAA JAT EXPRESS, Sleeper, ₹395 pp, 15 h  
- **Stay:** **Vindh Homestay** – ₹800 /night, 3★, free Wi‑Fi & breakfast, book on Booking.com  
- **Weather:** Cool winter, 8‑20 °C, clear skies  
- **Total cost:** ₹3,690 of ₹12,000 budget (₹8,310 left over)

## ✈️ Getting there & back
- **Go:** Train 13151 KOAA JAT EXPRESS, Dep 08:30 AM Kolkata (Howrah), Arr 11:30 PM Varanasi, Sleeper, ₹395 pp  
- **Return:** Train 13152 JAT EXPRESS, Dep 07:00 AM Varanasi, Arr 10:00 PM Kolkata, Sleeper, ₹395 pp  
- **Why this option:** Cheapest reliable mode; no extra airport taxes, and you get a night on the train saving a night’s accommodation.

## 🏨 Where to stay
1. **Vindh Homestay** — ₹800 /night · 3★ · free Wi‑Fi, breakfast, garden view · book on Booking.com  
2. **Sah Haveli** — ₹950 /night · 3★ · rooftop terrace, complimentary tea/coffee · book on MakeMyTrip  
3. **Shree Guest House** — ₹542 /night · 2★ · simple rooms, hot water, shared kitchen · book on OYO  

## 🗓️ Day-by-day plan
### Day 1 — Fri, 15 Jan · Arrival & Evening Aarti  
- **08:30 AM** — Board Train 13151 at Howrah (Sleeper, ₹395)  
- **11:30 PM** — Arrive Varanasi Railway Station, take auto‑rickshaw (₹50) to **Vindh Homestay**; check‑in (≈ 2 km, 10 min)  
- **12:30 AM** — Light snack at **Kachori & Samosa Lane** (near Dashashwamedh) – Kachori, ₹30 pp  
- **01:30 AM** — Walk to **Dashashwamedh Ghat** for the Ganga Aarti (free, open all night)  
- 💡 *Tip:* Wear warm layers; the riverfront gets chilly after dark.  

### Day 2 — Sat, 16 Jan · Ghats, Culture & Street Food  
- **06:00 AM** — Sunrise boat ride from **Assi Ghat** (shared boat, ₹150 pp, 30 min) – view ghats in early light  
- **07:30 AM** — Breakfast at **Shri Kashi Vishwanath Café** – Kachori Sabzi, ₹40 pp  
- **09:00 AM** — Walk to **Kashi Vishwanath Temple** (free, dress modestly)  
- **10:30 AM** — Explore **Sarnath** (bus 30 km, ₹100 pp, entry to Dhamek Stupa ₹50)  
- **01:00 PM** — Lunch at **Deena Chaat Bhandar** – Tamatar Chaat, ₹50 pp  
- **02:30 PM** — Return to city, stroll **Alamgir Mosque** & **Ramnagar Fort** (free, ferry ₹70 pp)  
- **05:00 PM** — Coffee break at **Madhurima Café** – Masala Chai, ₹30 pp  
- **06:30 PM** — Evening Aarti at **Manikarnika Ghat** (free)  
- **08:00 PM** – Dinner at **Kashi Chat Bhandar** – Golgappe, ₹40 pp  
- 💡 *Tip:* Carry a small bottle of water; many ghats have limited drinking water.  

### Day 3 — Sun, 17 Jan · Morning Walk & Return  
- **05:30 AM** — Walk along **Assi Ghat** for sunrise meditation (free)  
- **07:00 AM** — Breakfast at **Narayan Kothi** – Sattvik Thali, ₹120 pp  
- **08:30 AM** — Check‑out, auto‑rickshaw to Varanasi Railway Station (₹50)  
- **09:00 AM** — Board Train 13152 back to Kolkata (Sleeper, ₹395)  
- **10:00 PM** — Arrive Howrah, end of trip  

## 🍽️ Food to try
- **Kachori Sabzi** at **Kachori & Samosa Lane** — ₹30 pp  
- **Tamatar Chaat** at **Deena Chaat Bhandar** — ₹50 pp  
- **Golgappe** at **Kashi Chat Bhandar** — ₹40 pp  
- **Sattvik Thali** at **Narayan Kothi** — ₹120 pp  
- **Masala Chai** at **Madhurima Café** — ₹30 pp  

## 💰 Budget breakdown
| Item | Cost |
|---|---|
| Transport (train round‑trip) | ₹790 |
| Stay (2 nights) | ₹1,600 |
| Food (3 days × 1 person) | ₹900 |
| Local travel + activities | ₹200 |
| Buffer | ₹200 |
| **Total** | **₹3,690** |

## 🎒 Weather & packing
- Day temps 8‑20 °C; mornings & evenings cold – pack a sweater & light jacket.  
- Comfortable walking shoes for ghats and narrow alleys.  
- Small backpack with water bottle, hand sanitizer, and a scarf for temple visits.  

## 🏧 Useful nearby
- **ATM:** State Bank of India – near Vishwanath Temple  
- **Petrol:** Indian Oil Pump – 5 km from city centre (for auto‑rickshaws)  
- **Hospital:** Banaras Hindu University Hospital – 3 km, +91‑542‑236 0000  
- **Bus stand / Railway station:** Varanasi Junction (BSR) – main rail hub  

## 💡 Local tips
- Carry exact change (₹10‑₹100) for street vendors.  
- Dress modestly at temples (shoulders & knees covered).  
- Use only registered auto‑rickshaws; agree fare before boarding.  
- Keep a copy of your train ticket (digital or print) for quick verification.  
- No special permits needed for ghats or Sarnath; just a small entry fee for the stupa.
